batch_adjustment_policy.sensitivity_analysis: fold-local residualization may be performed only after the technical audit identifies a usable covariate; parameters are fit on training samples and applied unchanged to held-out samples

biological_claim_rule: Stable factors with a technical flag are retained in the audit but excluded from primary biological claims. Stable factors with unknown technical status require external recurrence evidence and an explicit limitation.

factor_status_taxonomy.stable_ambiguous_specimen_association: passes stability and associates only with an ambiguous specimen or site variable that may contain biological information
factor_status_taxonomy.stable_nontechnical: passes stability and no usable technical covariate meets the flagging rule
factor_status_taxonomy.stable_technical_flag: passes stability but has technical q<0.05 and exceeds the prespecified effect-size threshold
factor_status_taxonomy.stable_technical_status_unknown: passes stability but no usable sample-level technical metadata are available
factor_status_taxonomy.unstable: fails the upstream factor or subspace stability gate

field_usability_rules.date_derivation: calendar-quarter bins only if at least two usable levels and minimum level size is met

guardrails: Technical labels are not used to select the model family.
Clinical and outcome fields remain inaccessible.
High-cardinality identifiers cannot be used as covariates.
A reproducible factor is not assumed biological solely because it is stable.

post_representation_factor_association.binary: standardized mean difference and permutation p-value
post_representation_factor_association.continuous: absolute Spearman correlation with 10000 label permutations
post_representation_factor_association.multicategory: eta-squared from one-way model and permutation p-value
post_representation_factor_association.multiplicity: Benjamini-Hochberg within the separate technical-confound family

purpose: Inventory usable sample-level technical covariates without accessing clinical outcomes or using technical labels for model family selection.
